QuestInfo.name: Correcting the Past 4: Destroy, Destroy, Destroy!
QuestInfo.0: Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to destroy the OS3A machine that is defending the Processing Plant.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Processing Plant in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat #b#o9420074#s#k, who is commanding the plant's defense.
QuestInfo.2: You stopped #b#o9420074##k, who was defending the Processing Plant.

0.0: Do you remember what happened at the Processing Plant? You rode the OS3A Machine and defended the Processing Plant.
0.1: I will send you to the Processing Plant of the past using a black whole activation device.\r\nThere, you will fight the OS3A machines like the one you rode in the past.
0.2: Defeat as many machines as you can, so that the Processing Plant cannot be defended! \n\rDon't worry. The people in the machines won't be hurt.

yes.0: Don't worry, the pilots won't get hurt. Now, hurry!

no.0: Everything will return to normal if we correct the past...

1.0: You made it back! Good! Thanks to you, the plant doesn't have as many people to defend it!

yes.0: Still, the Processing Plant continues to operate. Please help us again tomorrow!

default.0: There are still many OS3A Machines defending the Processing Plant! Return to the past!
